untrustedWorkspaces.description: Gherkin editing is available in Restricted Mode. Step navigation uses a Python interpreter and requires a trusted workspace.

tooliumCucumber.jira.issueUrlTemplate.description: HTTP(S) URL used to open a Jira issue. Include (id) where the issue key belongs.

tooliumCucumber.jira.openInIntegratedBro.description: Open Jira issues in the VS Code integrated browser when available. Otherwise use the system browser.

tooliumCucumber.jira.bugPrefixes.description: Jira project prefixes eligible for bug reference searches. Specify project keys without the issue number or hyphen, for example TOOLIUM.

tooliumCucumber.pythonInterpreter.description: Python executable for step discovery. Paths may be absolute or relative to the workspace folder. By default, look for a nearby .venv and then use Python on PATH.

tooliumCucumber.stepImportPaths.description: Additional Python source roots for static step discovery. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace folder.

tooliumCucumber.resources.configurationP.description: Workspace-relative directories containing CONF JSON resources.

tooliumCucumber.resources.baseConfigurat.description: Base configuration filenames, shown before environment definitions. configurationExcludePatterns is applied even to these files.

tooliumCucumber.resources.poeditorPaths.description: Workspace-relative directories containing POEditor JSON arrays.

tooliumCucumber.resources.tooliumPaths.description: Workspace-relative directories containing toolium.cfg and local-toolium.cfg. Only these two filenames are searched, without recursion.

tooliumCucumber.resources.filePath.description: Workspace-relative base directory for FILE and FILE_UTF8 references.

tooliumCucumber.resources.base64Path.description: Workspace-relative base directory for BASE64 references.

tooliumCucumber.resources.poeditorSearch.description: POEditor key matching mode. Toolium defaults to contains; this extension keeps exact for compatibility.

tooliumCucumber.resources.poeditorKeyFie.description: POEditor object field containing lookup identifiers.

tooliumCucumber.resources.poeditorPrefix.description: POEditor prefixes tried in order before the unprefixed identifier. The first matching prefix across all files wins.

tooliumCucumber.resources.referencePaths.description: Workspace-relative directories searched recursively for literal LANG, CONF, POE and TOOLIUM usages in Python and feature files. An empty list disables searching.

tooliumCucumber.resources.configurationE.description: Case-insensitive workspace-relative globs excluded from CONF navigation, completion and reverse searches before reading files. Patterns without / match filenames at any depth. [] disables exclusions; overrides replace defaults.
